name: iPhone 13 Pro

bottom.datum: 0.00 at left of bottom view; view drawn with display up and camera bump down, so 0.00 is the phone's left edge as seen from the front

notes: Dimension numbers on this drawing are vector outlines, not PDF text: pg.get_text('words') returns only the title/footer, so the verbatim text check cannot confirm any value; every number was read visually from crops at 3.5x-12x zoom and cross-checked by symmetry about the centre ordinate and by an independent tesseract OCR pass over the rendered sheet (which found all but a handful of the values; those were re-read at higher zoom). centreLine values are measured across the thickness (about half of it); which face they are taken from was not determined. Lens diameters: 'dia 15.53' (no multiplier) points at rear camera 2 and 'dia 15.80' at rear camera 3; rear camera 1 has no diameter callout, so its d is null (it is drawn the same size as camera 2). Flash diameter is not dimensioned; rear mic position is not dimensioned (only dia 1.15; it is inside the plateau, lower right). LiDAR is not drawn or dimensioned. Plateau = outermost camera outline; inner outline at x 4.27-39.28, y 4.27-40.51. Plateau corner radius not dimensioned. Corner table differs between axes in one entry: across-width list has 11.43 (reported), down-length list has 11.42. SIM tray (centre 83.69, directly below the volume buttons): width 2.66 and a 1.33 tray-edge-to-centre dimension, but no centre-line distance from a face, so centreLine is null. The '2X 3.06' volume-width label on the left view is partly overprinted by an arrow; 3.06 is confirmed by the clean '3.06' on the right view. Ring/silent values are for the POCKET (32.22, 3.75 'POCKET CENTER', 2X 2.90, 2.15 width). Connector width not dimensioned (height 2.30; keepout 13.65 x 6.85; ordinates 31.74 and 39.79 straddle the 35.76 centre). Bottom ordinates: 19.14 25.18 29.37 31.74 39.79 42.16 46.34 56.89; Detail C gives 3.80 and the bottom view 3.75 for the port centre-line. Button protrusion: switch 0.60, volume 0.45, side 0.45.
